name: The Millpond
description: An old millpond near Millhaven, still and green, where the village children fish for sunfish on summer evenings.

discovery.message: A lane off the road leads to a quiet pond behind a broken-down mill.

pond.text: The pond lies still behind the old mill race, lily pads crowding the edges. Sunfish turn in the shallows, and the carp are fat and lazy.

leave.text: You leave the pond to the dragonflies.
